audit:
Main RC closure checklist, pinned-source audit

Baseline inspected: committed `c5f65fd9d14925b8abec3717318dec943a473587`.
The named Mode4 `3cc39cf2` and caller-StartOnly `bbcd706b` batch was pending
at audit start; Root advanced to committed `a94ea4c7` during this audit. Treat
those two components as integrated by that later commit, with the broad release
gate Parent-owned. Root's separate initial Mode4 scope-observation encoder fix
is not the same source as the original author3cc freeze. INPUTS.json preserves
58 exact read inputs and verifies both complete author manifests. This is a
read-only source/API audit; no new Core test execution is claimed.

Already present: native rows and streaming catchup, real awaited metadata PCs,
same-owner Before/Intermediate/Post and control-ACK recovery, and completed-row
publication. The new retained-consensus borrower also lends the SAME caller
invocation into actual catchup/Kernel and retains the detached index child.
`ConsensusReady` is therefore no longer a wholly missing ordinary handoff.
See [retained consensus](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_retained_consensus_session_impl.rs:91)
and [committed publication](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_completed_install_impl.rs:1).

1. **Execute and journal retained caller controls beyond Start.** The new raw
   codec defines AdvanceCaller/EnterConsensus/AdvanceDetached/AppendSelected/
   ResolveSelectedPost and two timer lanes, but the durable controller commits
   only its constructor and stops at StartAcknowledged. That is not fulfillment
   of Initialize. Its moved caller remains private, so an RC driver cannot just
   extract it and invoke the ordinary controller. Smallest next operational
   milestone: durable AdvanceCaller plus CallerDelay fire, then the actual
   origin-bound consensus/selected-operation controls; compare full raw actions
   and actual observations before Accepted/ACK. Preserve distinct caller result
   and detached-child lifetime. [Source caller awaits](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/fixtures/legacy_main_source.txt:142),
   [raw actions](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/named-batch/Caller-StartOnly/src/source_main_retained_caller_action.rs:19),
   [Start-only stop](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/named-batch/Caller-StartOnly/src/source_main_retained_caller_start_wal_impl.rs:369).

2. **Add selected-caller native recovery without replaying source.** The warm
   retained consensus owner can select and append its three actual operation
   kinds, but it has no public no-index/reopen/supersession exit. An attempted
   write is retained and another append refuses. Ordinary row and direct Mode4
   recovery exist; they cannot silently select the caller's first pending job.
   Next: reuse sealed metadata reopen and durable mapping for the exact stored
   route/kind/job/method/ordinal/role, preserving the same financial/frame owner,
   then resolve Post once. [Attempt fence](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_retained_consensus_session_impl.rs:214),
   [Post-only resolve](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_retained_consensus_session_impl.rs:249),
   [existing direct inline recovery](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_inline_wal_recovery_impl.rs:145).

3. **Close the remaining literal startup/caller value branches.** Ordered
   bootstrap implements explicit TxUtils import versus static-index promises,
   handlers and notifications. It is not the whole Main module's init/Activation
   IIFEs. Adoption explicitly requires a closed bootstrap and a typed configured
   client. Initialize retains 1500ms, but its prefix refuses the uninitialized/
   no-chain branch instead of executing the original global-db behavior and
   300ms/initialize waits. SyncIndex admits only nonnegative safe Numbers;
   JavaScript accepts coercive values and `null` starts a real detached
   initOrLoad call before continuing. Next small source milestone: characterize
   primitive coercive Sync inputs first; preserve original max argument bytes,
   swallowed source errors and actual index child. Do not turn null's extra
   job or a failed global-db dereference into successful initialization.
   [Module IIFEs](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/fixtures/legacy_main_source.txt:12),
   [source initialize/sync](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/fixtures/legacy_main_source.txt:142),
   [current prefix](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_retained_caller_runtime_impl.rs:713),
   [adoption fence](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_owners.rs:81).

4. **Compose real file-retry suspension into the active service/caller lane.**
   Existing file-step code supports literal safeCopy/safeDelete retry frames.
   The actual active-service preflight still refuses copy/unlink EBUSY/EPERM,
   and its primitive owner rejects File operations. This is an explicit scope
   gate, not evidence that source retries are complete in the RC path. Next:
   lend that same owner into the existing retry frame through snapshot work,
   preserving partial file writes, all five attempts/final 50ms wait, ENOENT,
   pause/height/shutdown interleavings and pending caller identity.
   [Current refusal](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_service_runtime_impl.rs:110),
   [File primitive fence](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_service_io_impl.rs:151),
   [existing file profile](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_step_file_core_impl.rs:1).

5. **Complete cold source replay for Mode4 recovery and retained callers.**
   The committed ordinary cold runner really reexecutes raw actions and compares
   complete Before/Accepted observations, but accepts the ordinary HISTORY type,
   rejects recovery/supersession and changed publication, and ends read-only.
   Mode4's new verifier closes a narrower metadata relation and does not supply
   the ordinary runner type or a financial result. Next: a distinct sealed cold
   composition that reexecutes actual raw source actions/selected caller PCs
   against verified original/copied views, and compares all observations before
   any live release. Do not widen the old reader by accepting a new hash/profile.
   [Actual cold type](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_cold_active_reexecution_impl.rs:76),
   [recovery/publication refusals](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_cold_active_reexecution_impl.rs:211),
   [new metadata-only closure](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/named-batch/Mode4-physical-ACK/src/source_main_mode4_inline_closure_impl.rs:8).

6. **Provide a recorded factual IO feed for an open-ended live run.** The service
   currently captures a fixed documents array at Start; other actions cannot
   supply a new raw RPC document/tip. The production adapter reads fixed
   height/network/blocks facts and failures by ordinal. That is useful replay
   input, but not a continuously advancing node input path. Next: an explicit
   bounded factual-input action/capability with raw bytes and ordinal/context
   binding; keep decode/validation/financial results computed by the source.
   [Live source RPC loop](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/fixtures/legacy_main_source.txt:614),
   [current action surface](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_service_session_impl.rs:20),
   [fixed IO facts](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_production_impl.rs:243).

7. **Make active-service history rotate without releasing a stale owner.**
   Native index paging/compaction and segmented step history do not remove the
   active service's separate 4096-action admission stop. It has no ordinary
   Session/head release or active-service segment publication API. Next: a
   distinct acknowledged active-history publication/continuation seam retaining
   the same owner and independently pinned source/physical head. Demonstrate
   progress across the actual limit, not just more store rows.
   [Bound and closed owner](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_service_session_impl.rs:1),
   [before-effect capacity gate](C:/Users/patri/Documents/Codex/2026-10-26/go/work/main-rc-gap-audit-v13/inputs/committed/src/source_main_native_service_session_impl.rs:508).

These are source/owner composition gates, not a claim that every transaction
logic method is missing. Successful shutdown must retain the source's literal
no-save/process-exit behavior; the comment in JS is not a financial checkpoint
implementation. Reorg restoration must likewise preserve what the pinned source
actually copies/reopens, without inventing a balance rollback or new economics.
No source checksum, recorded IO fact, trace or claimed actor supplies authority.
